content:
alex: Ran into crash on Vercel Edge: `TypeError: require is not defined` after upgrading the SDK to v2. The quickstart sample still had a `require()` line.
tia: Are they using `type: "module"`? Edge and ESM-only projects will throw on `require`.
gary: We need to ship dual entrypoints and document imports. Recommended package.json snippet: `"exports": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.js", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js" }`.
lia: Also seeing TS pain: `No overload matches this call` when calling `createClient()` with no args. Our overloads currently require `model` in one variant which breaks inference.
tia: Proposed public signature: `function createClient<T = any>(opts?: ClientOptions & { model?: T }): Client<T>` — simple, ergonomic default to `any`. For strict usecases we can provide `createStrictClient<T extends Model>(opts: ClientOptions & { model: T }): Client<T>`.
gary: On the `unknown` vs `any` debate: keep `unknown` internally, but export aliases for ergonomics: `type SDKResponse<T = any> = ResponsePayload<T>`, and helper `parseResponse<T = any>(r: SDKResponse<T>): T`. That avoids forcing casts in common flows.
alex: The user also had runtime failures because their bundler inlined `process.env` checks at module top-level. Edge doesn't have `process`. Add guards: `const apiKey = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env.API_KEY : globalThis.__REDWOOD_API_KEY;` and avoid `Buffer` / sync `fs` in examples.
tia: Add a minimal Edge example: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference/esm'` plus tsconfig snippet we can copy into the docs: { "compilerOptions": { "module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "target": "ES2020", "esModuleInterop": true } }.
gary: CI changes: run a tsserver matrix (TS 4.9, 5.0, 5.1) and a lint job that fails if `require(` is present in `examples/edge-*`.helps catch CJS patterns.
lia: Also update migration guide: show both ESM (`import`) and CJS (`require`) usage and explain when Edge needs the ESM import path.
devex-bot: Created issue #3399: "dx: SDK TS ergonomics + ESM/CJS edge guide" and linked this thread.
alex: I'll draft a PR that adds the permissive overload, `SDKResponse` alias, the minimal example repo under `examples/edge-minimal`, and the tsconfig/package.json snippets. Will ping for review.
